posts.name: Riya Sethi
posts.cooked:
Respected sir/Ma’am,

Due personal urgent reasons, i wasn’t able to submit the BPT-1 and my BPT-2 submission failed despite showing evaluation and submission successful.

I have submitted the BPT-3 and all of my answers are correct.

I am already repeating the SC course, I would be highly grateful if you could tell me a way to attend the OPPE for it.

I want to becime eligible for OPPE- please help. I would do whatever that can be done.

I have read the grading document and I understand the criteria.

But please help and I have no terms left.

I will be highly grateful to you

Regards.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Hello Riya,

If you are repeat OPPE this term, all you had to do was just run synchro eval in the BPT questions, that would have taken not more than 5 minutes even if you didn’t have the time as previous term submissions were there. Also, I think you know the procedure to submit answers in VM by now.No exceptions will be provided. Can you share were you OPPE ineligible previous term or did you give your OPPE?

Please read the Repeat_OPPE criteria below -

image867×617 42.9 KB

Thanks & Regards,
Swati Jain

posts.name: Jayesh Bansal
posts.cooked:
Respected Ma’am,

I hope you are doing well.

I am writing to bring to your kind attention that I am currently facing an issue regarding my OPPE eligibility. I had successfully submitted BPT-2; however, due to unavoidable personal reasons, I was unable to log in and complete BPT-3.

At present, I am repeating the OPPE, and this is the only remaining course required for me to complete my diploma. If I am deemed ineligible to attend the OPPE, it would result in the loss of an entire semester for just this one requirement.

In this regard, I humbly request you to kindly consider allowing me to appear for the OPPE. I am willing to submit BPT-4 and meet the required criteria so that my average BPT score reaches the minimum 50%, enabling me to pass the OPPE and progress to the next term without delay.

I sincerely request your understanding and consideration of my situation. I would be extremely grateful if you could provide me with a way to become eligible for the OPPE.

Thank you for your time and support.

Regards

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
I understand the problem but please go through this BPT 3 - Request for consideration - #3.

As the instructor mentioned, if we make special considerations for certain people it won’t be fair for people who submitted assignments on time.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Did you read the above message that I have posted?

Can you share were you OPPE ineligible previous term or did you give your OPPE?

posts.name: Jayesh Bansal
posts.cooked:
Thank you for the response sir.

I would like add that this term is my repeat OPPE and not the regular course. The instructor mentioned that as thet cannot consider due passed deadline, that means they may have copied but as I am doing repeat OPPE, I already had answers but I was not able to login and synchro eval due to personal reasons. What I am trying to say is not to consider my marks or something like that. I just need eligibility for writing OPPE as in the previous term, I was eligible. Considering my previous term eligibility, I would like to write OPPE.

Thank you for your time and support

Regards

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: I am sorry if this comes off as insensitive in context of your personal reasons for not submitting the BPTs, but given that you were just repeating your OPPE your task was trivially simple. You just had to run synchro eval for all your BPTs. No exceptions will be made.
